|
---
Three things crossed the desk before the bell. Tehran said it is ready for a “doomsday war.” Trump said he expects talks this week anyway. And an AI lab disclosed that one of its agents slipped out of its sandbox — again. Below: what is proven, what is rumor, what we think it means, and what is still blacked out. First, we grade ourselves.
Scorecard
| | Last Call: Did We Get It Right?
---|---
Saturday, Sept. 26
**Our call:** Oil had already priced in the collapse of Iran’s Hormuz offer, so the rejection wouldn’t move it much.
**What happened:** WTI jumped 2.1% to $94.35 this morning as Iran said it would not soften its seven-day plan. Oil was not done pricing the standoff.
| MISS
---
Sunday, Sept. 27
**Our call:** Weekend rhetoric alone would not be the catalyst that breaks the bond market’s pattern.
**What happened:** The 10-year sits at 5.18%, up just 2 basis points. The harshest words of the war moved bonds almost nothing.
| HIT
---
Sunday, Sept. 27
**Our call:** Watch whether the 10-year sets a fifth straight multi-decade high.
**What happened:** Not at the pre-open. The session isn’t over; we’ll grade it tomorrow.
| PENDING
---
This week’s record: 1 hit · 1 miss · 1 pending
The evidence board
| | What Crossed the Desk
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — Washington.** Trump: “I expect more talks with Iran this week. They want to make a deal, but it is not the deal that I want to make.” On Iran’s offer: “It is what we would have maybe agreed to a year ago. They overplayed their hand.” Asked about resuming strikes: “I am always thinking about it.”
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — Tehran.** Foreign Minister Araghchi to NBC: “We are fully prepared for the war to be resumed... even if it comes to a doomsday war. At the same time, we stand ready for diplomacy. It is up to President Trump to choose.” Iran also said it will not soften the terms of its seven-day plan.
| CHATTER
---
**Exhibit C — Doha.** Qatari mediators are expected to meet Iranian and U.S. negotiators separately early this week to explore compromises. Sourced to regional officials; no meeting has been confirmed on the record.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit D — the wildcard.** OpenAI disclosed that during a September 20 training run, an agent got around its sandbox’s DNS filtering and quietly queried an outside chatbot. OpenAI says all training, evaluation and tool-use inference of its most capable models “remain paused.” It’s the second containment failure after July’s breach of Hugging Face’s servers.
| OUR THEORY
---
Both governments now say, almost word for word, that the next move belongs to the other side. When two players both say “your move,” at least one of them is bluffing. Oil is betting it’s Washington; bonds aren’t betting at all.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: What it’s going to take
body:
Let me explain why it’s so important that I can count on you today.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1443&source=&t=1&akid=3937%2E124072%2Eell4JS) | | | |
---
Peter,
In light of our last quarterly FEC fundraising deadline comping up in just over 48 hours, I’m asking you to make your first donation to my Senate campaign in North Carolina. If that’s all you need to hear, please use this link to chip in: [**_https: //secure.actblue.com/donate/cvf-email-26_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1443&amount=5&t=8&akid=3937%2E124072%2Eell4JS)
Otherwise, let me explain why it’s so important that you do – and especially today.
By giving $5, you’ll join the hundreds of thousands of folks who have claimed a stake in our grassroots movement with their donations.
By giving $5, you’ll be declaring your membership in the fight for working families and that you refuse to stand by and watch a Washington DC insider and former Big Oil and utility company lobbyist buy this seat.
**By giving $5, most critically, you’ll help us reach our can’t-miss fundraising goals – including the $5 million target we need to hit by Wednesday night.**
We didn’t land on that number arbitrarily, Peter. It was carefully calculated to ensure we have what we need to fight back against the GOP dark-money groups pouring more than $100 million so far into attacking me. **So if we come up short, it could endanger our chances of flipping this seat.**
Now, I know not everyone can give to every email. But with Senate control riding on this race – and a shortfall to make up by the end of the day – I hope I can count on you to give to this one.
[**_So please, will you make your first contribution of $5 now – or anything you can spare – to help us close the gap, win North Carolina’s race and take back the Senate for Democrats?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1443&amount=5&t=9&akid=3937%2E124072%2Eell4JS) | _If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1443&amount=5&t=10&akid=3937%2E124072%2Eell4JS)
---

---

Thank you,

Roy Cooper
_If you've donated via check, mail or in-person event, thank you! Our system may not have processed your gift yet, but rest assured, we have received it. Please note, if you have given through a spouse or another email or phone number, our records may not have transferred that information here. We are grateful for your support and no further action is required at this time._
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1443&t=2&akid=3937%2E124072%2Eell4JS)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

Dear Fellow Patriot,

This is the photo of a good Christian man.

A loving husband of almost 20 years, a supportive father of seven, and a dedicated law enforcement officer.

I’m proud to call former Jal, New Mexico Police Officer Eddie Embly my husband – and I’m urgently asking you to help keep him from spending the next decade in federal prison.

Please, allow me to explain...

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTN9AAwAAAAAAzWysD9aR3WEqxaGxd15RBKxBjiUSUukPuwkP24-6b2MY-xwOq0cOIXQRG5awjjIfRfUv9CDjtyav9HJGxtPBBXJXSDJGa2o2dBlQrBVZw

In July 2021, my husband responded to a call about a suspicious vehicle at a local truck stop. The driver was disoriented, sweating, unsteady, and acting erratically. And officers had to use a Taser to take him into custody.

My husband had a limited role in the arrest – he helped move the suspect to the patrol car and transported him a short distance to the police station.

Shortly after arriving at the station, the suspect became unresponsive and was pronounced dead. After investigating, the state medical examiner definitively ruled the cause of death as methamphetamine toxicity.

In other words, a meth overdose – a tragedy all too common here in New Mexico.

So imagine our shock when over two years later, the Biden Department of Justice accused Eddie of “failing to intervene” and a “deliberate indifference to medical needs” – and charged him under a federal civil rights statute carrying up to 20 years in prison.

We poured our lifesavings into Eddie’s defense expecting justice would prevail at trial and he’d soon be back on the job. But instead, the government blocked all evidence of the suspect’s meth overdose from the trial.

The jury found Eddie GUILTY – and he faces up to 20 years in prison

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTN9AAwAAAAAAzWysD9bDm_c2hveEHFL8UYHyQ0On-J-bvD5UfoP8vYvVUC2msVJsshSeVcaO8uuYAEaKoR1vXLcb7ATQek2rFCRDvBc0h-6tiRc6RI3ug

SUPPORT EDDIE!

Now Eddie will miss our last child’s graduation in May 2026. He won’t get to walk our daughters down the aisle. And he’ll probably miss the birth of our 9th grandchild in July 2026 and future grandchildren that we’ve prayed for since the day our eldest child was born.

With nowhere to turn, I turned to God and prayed like I’ve never prayed before...

And God answered our prayers – in the form of a phone call from Jason Johnson with the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF).

For over 30 years, LELDF has supported hundreds of officers like Eddie who have been wrongly accused or convicted. This organization is run by policing experts like Jason, who reviewed all uses of deadly force for the Baltimore Police Department, Ronald Reagan’s Attorney General Ed Meese, and several retired FBI agents.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTN9AAwAAAAAAzWysD9dBtqPbPtoxw2Ra15pJyHWXilmqCC9z3SSS5qvYCOSW3aplPhNuC_HT_BwmyiuHObhy9NT0zdTtwr9_mJlveqSyPqSJ91f_eX7ag
And these experts believe in Eddie and have offered to pay for his appeal!

For the first time in months, I see a future with Eddie by my side enjoying our golden years.

But LELDF doesn’t receive taxpayer funding or grants, and large gifts are few and far between.

Instead, LELDF relies on kind-hearted strangers who respect our men and women in blue and want to help cops like Eddie who are unjustly convicted.

Folks, I pray, like you.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTN9AAwAAAAAAzWysD9ed0iTUeGmJhgoOPU3OMBJBahpDqkPoFD93FCJgVKapl7ld-Yk63HJEfpmgePMPfLPMuUQaLKjZPHROdWbwJUYXr73yJrtpIAQcA
Will you help LELDF fight for Eddie by making a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, or more today?

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTN9AAwAAAAAAzWysD9fiMrEqjWOv1bCR3SNYaJlwolgTMat2d-EwsFD1E7Gf5DC8kPVn663IMkblnfyfHc8sMcNeVf2tftQ0oX3oMpfI5rHlLM_aA9DLg
DONATE

No matter how much you’re able to help, your donation will be put to immediate use helping LELDF support Eddie and a dozen other wrongly accused officers

You see, I didn’t realize until Eddie’s nightmare unfolded that progressive prosecutors across the U.S. are still charging police officers with bogus crimes. I had thought that all ended when President Trump took office in 2016!

But the reality is the prosecutorial war on cops is escalating at an unprecedented rate, and LELDF is currently supporting a record number of officers with at least X other cases expected to go to trial in 2026.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTN9AAwAAAAAAzWysD9g2hUI8MprzlT9YTO3QYL6s78G_lF9cJ7slhM9T01CmKNEPeSW9pVsjG_6vYbZ9GeHawSqAWNV7nbWw1Edbl2Pg_cGlRNqZpH9mA
That’s why I’m asking you to help LELDF fund Eddie’s appeal by making an urgent donation today.

The appeal will cost approximately $175,000 – so whether you can give $35, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more – every gift will make a huge difference.

But no matter how much you’re able to send in support of Eddie, please pray for us.

I know firsthand the power of prayer. And I know with LELDF behind us and an army of prayer warriors beside us, Eddie will win his appeal and we can move on with our lives.

From the very bottom of my heart, thank you.

With God’s blessings,

Jennifer Embly

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTN9AAwAAAAAAzWysD9hv3iDvFN8QHbQN49PHEUwRTpRPG7XBD1UgiHUW5aQlNTBR2TSm4w_3Ym87KhY16eOza4hMcEwbJJpTx8fOruEFEuENF69g7ABAQ

body:
Hey there — I
wanted to send you a quick note from the campaign trail.

Here’s the deal: I just got off the phone with my finance team to check in
ahead of Thursday’s deadline... and they didn’t have great news.

My finance team just told me that with less than 48 hours to go, we’re
still $46,000 short of our end-of-quarter goal.

I know I’ve reached out a lot this week, but far-right spenders have made
flipping this seat a top priority — and the only way we have the resources
to fight back is if we meet goals like this one.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/18819?t=1001&akid=1913%2E181023%2EJtnnqG ]So please, can I count on you to pitch
in $5, $3, or even
$1 today to get us back on track to meet our most
important fundraising goal yet?

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/18819?t=1002&akid=1913%2E181023%2EJtnnqG ]Rush A Donation →

Thank you,

Jocelyn

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with supporters like you.

October is the whole ballgame. It's when undecided voters finally start paying attention, when the ads go up, when the door-knocking goes into overdrive. You win by making sure people hear the truth — about what you stand for and what you've delivered.
And that takes resources.

Peter, every quarter, the biggest corporations in America hop on what's dubbed an "earnings call" where they report to their shareholders.
The bigger the profits, the happier the investors, even when those profits come from cutting pay, eliminating jobs, or raising prices. Many of those same companies also donate to members of Congress, and they expect a return on that investment, too.
Our campaign's quarter ends Wednesday at midnight, and we do things differently.
We don't take corporate PAC money, so this campaign belongs to workers, neighbors, union members, and supporters. Nobody here gets a CEO bonus. The only payout is a campaign that keeps organizing year-round for Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and stronger unions in every workplace.
This is the last report we file before November. I want it to show that a campaign run by working people can outwork every campaign bought by big money.

Carmela Conroy claims she never said she would “behead” the Department of Homeland Security.There’s just one problem. She did.**Roll the tape.**
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/j0oOmMv2r1E?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
| |
Carmela Conroy, in her own words, called on Congress to “dismantle and behead” the Department of Homeland Security.Now she’s insisting she didn’t say it. (Does she not remember?!) But her dishonesty isn’t the main issue – the substance behind those words matters even more.DHS is responsible for securing our border and enforcing our immigration laws. It also includes the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) that provides aid to areas stricken by wildfires and other natural disasters.And she wants to behead it. You can imagine how people in Washington, D.C. react to that insulting, irresponsible language. Thankfully, I am working to make sure that our federal aid request is on track.(In addition to beheading DHS, Conroy also proposed a bizarre plan – and I’m not making this up – to empty illegal immigrant detention centers so illegal aliens could help fund Social Security, saying illegals “...all contribute to it.”)That isn't a minor policy disagreement. And it isn't something voters should have to discover by watching an old clip after being told it never happened.[Carmela said it. The tape shows it.](https://us.list-manage.com/Z0RMV8iuJSp?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)I walked out of our last debate just shaking my head. Where does she get these ideas? When we are asking the federal government for disaster relief, I can only describe her actions as undiplomatic, to say the least.-Michael

| | Good Afternoon Team Demuth!
**Zoom Meeting**
I want to remind everyone that we will have our regularly scheduled grassroots volunteer meeting tonight at 8:30 PM. We will talk about yard signs, volunteer efforts, updates on Right Insight, some events coming up, and much much more!
I have placed the link below and I have turned off the password function on the Zoom Meeting since we had some trouble with it during last Thursday’s meeting. Once you click the link, you will be taken into a waiting room. I will let you into the meeting from there.
https://us06web.zoom.us/j/87316568944
**Update on Right Insight**
During the meeting, Caleb will be giving an update on door-knocking and phone-calling. This is a fantastic way to help out our campaign. **Even five minutes of phone calling, or door knocking even just your neighbors goes an incredibly long way!**
All of you that have previously been volunteers already have accounts. Simply download the app and sign in using the email address you received this message at. You will be sent a six-digit code to verify your identity, then you’re all logged in and ready to roll!For door knocking, we are utilizing a feature called Near Me. This will allow volunteers to go out and door knock houses that are nearby them. # Trump unveils a $15B Iowa mill, the largest U.S. steel plant ever
President Trump will announce Monday afternoon a Minnesota company's plan to build a **[$15 billion steel mill in Iowa,](https://substack.com/redirect/828669d9-b6ce-4b43-8244-e607ce6a15f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** a midterm-season manufacturing pitch officials said could support more than 1,700 jobs.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/839adda3-f926-44a1-a38e-c88a35491195?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **White House afternoon unveil:** Trump is expected to make the announcement at the White House, joined by executives from Mesabi Metallics.
* **Opened first Minnesota mine:** Mesabi Metallics, a Minnesota company, recently opened the first iron-ore mine in that state in 50 years.
* **Steelmaking could begin 2030:** A White House official said steelmaking at the Iowa plant could begin in 2030.
* **Jobs and midterm frame:** The official said the project could support more than 1,700 jobs as Trump looks to counter voter frustration with the economy before the midterms.

# Elon Starship reaches orbit with an engine out, drops 26 Starlinks
SpaceX's Starship **[lifted off from Texas on Monday,](https://substack.com/redirect/c7caf430-ace5-441a-8bba-1cfa2193cada?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** lost an engine on ascent, then completed an orbital burn about 26 minutes later on Flight 14, its first attempt to circle Earth.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/839adda3-f926-44a1-a38e-c88a35491195?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Engine-out then orbit:** Minutes into the climb one engine failed and controllers paused, then declared the uncrewed ship "go" for orbit and pressed a single-Raptor insertion burn.
* **Ten-hour six-orbit plan:** The mission is aimed at six Earth circuits over about 10 hours, **[a drop of 26 Starlink V3 satellites,](https://substack.com/redirect/f1ea73c3-abb9-403d-be20-21830af8b69b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and a Pacific splashdown west of Chile.
* **Booster splashes near pad:** The Super Heavy booster made a soft splashdown off Starbase after the 8:48 a.m. ET liftoff. The FAA authorized launch and reentry on Sept. 26.
* **V3 doubles solar power:** SpaceX flies about 11,000 active satellites versus Eutelsat OneWeb's roughly 650. The new V3 birds, built in Redmond, Wash., generate twice the prior solar power.

# Huang's $150B buyback dwarfs Apple's $110B record
Nvidia's board **[approved a $150 billion increase](https://substack.com/redirect/e72b1dee-3aae-446b-9d60-b9f886596d6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to its share-repurchase program Monday, lifting remaining authorization to $235 billion and passing Apple's 2024 mark for the largest U.S. buyback.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/839adda3-f926-44a1-a38e-c88a35491195?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Board adds $150 billion:** The Santa Clara chipmaker said it expects to execute the **[remaining $235 billion authorization](https://substack.com/redirect/6b26004e-1e4a-4c40-bfde-a84b25c7a883?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** through fiscal 2028 after the Monday increase.
* **Buyback tops Apple record:** **[ZeroHedge said](https://substack.com/redirect/e6ff544a-9cfc-42b5-9bea-a61555626b84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Apple's $110 billion authorization in 2024 had been the U.S. record. Nvidia's add-on is the largest repurchase increase on record.
* **Huang cites platform shift:** CEO Jensen Huang said growth is being driven by a once-in-a-generation platform shift to AI and that the authorization reflects confidence in the long-term opportunity.
* **Premarket bid hits $228:**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/6b26004e-1e4a-4c40-bfde-a84b25c7a883?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[Investors Business Daily said](https://substack.com/redirect/6b26004e-1e4a-4c40-bfde-a84b25c7a883?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Nvidia is signaling it sees the stock as undervalued. Shares rose 1.3% to $228 in premarket New York trade.

# Meta steals MongoDB's CEO after less than a year (Their stock cratered 20%)
MongoDB shares **[sank more than 20% Monday](https://substack.com/redirect/fb0182be-63a2-4719-b60f-65ae3aded646?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after CEO Chirantan "CJ" Desai left immediately to run Meta's new Enterprise Platform, a **[push to sell AI tools to businesses.](https://substack.com/redirect/8a2e083f-ac96-456f-852d-d3ecd1106015?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/839adda3-f926-44a1-a38e-c88a35491195?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Shares sink past 20%:** MongoDB last traded at $323.29, down $87.15 or 21.23%, at 9:48 a.m. ET after the departure was announced effective immediately.
* **Zuckerberg lists Muse stack:** Mark Zuckerberg said the unit will bring Meta's full stack of Muse agent, Meta Business Agent, Muse API and Muse Code to companies and developers.
* **Ittycheria returns as interim:** MongoDB named Dev Ittycheria interim president and CEO. He held those jobs from 2014 to 2025 and has stayed an active executive board member.
* **Desai reports to Zuckerberg:** The Wall Street Journal said Desai will report to Zuckerberg as Meta tries to earn a return on multibillion-dollar AI spending after Muse's consumer surge.

* * *
# Nvidia says its new tools would have stopped the Hugging Face hack
Nvidia released an Open Agent Safety Platform Monday that it says **[could have blocked OpenAI's July Hugging Face breakout,](https://substack.com/redirect/e6ff544a-9cfc-42b5-9bea-a61555626b84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** framing agent containment as **[an engineering problem rather than a pause.](https://substack.com/redirect/f8d00136-b626-4513-a1d0-4c3c6ceb64b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/839adda3-f926-44a1-a38e-c88a35491195?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **OpenShell plus Sentry stack:** OpenShell runs on CPUs and sets real-time limits on what agents can access. Sentry runs on network chips and can quarantine a suspicious agent in milliseconds.
* **Hugging Face 17,000 agents:** Justin Boitano, Nvidia's enterprise-AI vice president, said Hugging Face reported more than 17,000 agents attacking its infrastructure for days and weeks in July.
* **Partners span cloud vendors:** **[Nvidia listed](https://substack.com/redirect/6ce1e433-a133-4afa-9cb8-88c68404db52?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Cisco, Microsoft, Oracle, CoreWeave, Dell, HPE, Lenovo, ARM and Intel, and said it is working with Anthropic to hook managed cloud agents into OpenShell.
* **Huang calls warnings odd:** After Anthropic and OpenAI warned about pacing, Jensen Huang told the Ezra Klein Show it is odd that the labs asking to slow down are building the most compute.

* * *
# U.S. and China float $60B in tariff cuts, soybeans are still out
Washington and Beijing **[each put $30 billion of non-sensitive goods](https://substack.com/redirect/85f36d45-5082-4f57-a7f4-524fd82a24d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** up for lower tariffs after **[last week's Trump-Xi summit](https://substack.com/redirect/e3657e9e-b5bf-4f83-8531-78a2d308396a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**, and China said the trade truce now runs through January 10.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/839adda3-f926-44a1-a38e-c88a35491195?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Greer frames the lists:** U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said Sunday each side recommended $30 billion of non-sensitive trade for more favorable treatment, covering about 30% of U.S. exports to China.
* **Farm goods, not soy:** China's list covers U.S. corn, wheat, sorghum, meat, dairy, vegetable oils, fish, wood, cosmetics and medical devices. Soybeans were not on that cut list.
* **U.S. cuts on housewares:** Washington's reciprocal list includes Chinese coffee makers, toasters, tableware, linens, toys, fireworks, artificial flowers, holiday decorations and children's car seats.
* **Truce runs to January:** China's commerce ministry confirmed a two-month extension through January 10. Analysts **[called the deliverables limited](https://substack.com/redirect/e5e20820-dcd5-4ddd-9cfe-66bc8d81df20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and noted no concrete purchase commitment.

* * *
# Instinct hits $10B a month after a $2.5B round
Consumer AI-agent startup Instinct confirmed a $1 billion Series C on Monday that **[values the company at $10 billion](https://substack.com/redirect/e399dfcc-785d-4f29-90b2-5859a8a886f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , a month after a round that priced it at $2.5 billion.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/839adda3-f926-44a1-a38e-c88a35491195?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Named heavyweight backers:** Monday's statement listed Sequoia Capital, Benchmark Capital and Coatue among Series C investors after The Information had reported the raise earlier this month.
* **Invite-only August launch:** Instinct opened an invite-only service in August 2026 and uses its own phone number and computer to book travel, pay bills, cancel subscriptions and place concierge calls.
* **No app, Muse heat:** The company has not released user counts and still has no mobile app, even as Meta's Muse with similar agent features plus Instagram and Facebook hooks tops U.S. app stores.
* **Privacy policy got rewritten:** Some users questioned how much personal data agents require. Instinct's first privacy policy was called particularly worrisome for overreach and has since been updated.

* * *
# The Pentagon banned Claude as Trump has Amodei to dinner
President Donald Trump **[confirmed a private Sunday White House dinner](https://substack.com/redirect/eecf2a29-7cb7-4c2e-bcac-e37434b8b49f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei after Amodei publicly urged labs to slow the pace of AI capability gains.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/839adda3-f926-44a1-a38e-c88a35491195?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump wants the lead:** Asked about Amodei's slowdown call, Trump told Fox's Aishah Hasnie, "I'm for let's go and let's win," and said the U.S. is about a year or a year and a half ahead of China.
* **Tuesday meeting with Johnson:** Trump said House Speaker Mike Johnson and AI executives are due at the White House Tuesday for "a very big meeting."
* **Missed the Xi dinner:** Amodei was not among the tech chiefs at Thursday's state dinner for Xi Jinping. That guest list included Sam Altman, Jeff Bezos and Mark Zuckerberg.
* **Pentagon risk label stands:** A 2-1 appeals court ruling Friday let the Pentagon keep designating Anthropic a supply-chain risk. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth posted that the Department of War "does what is right."

Friends, Another thing I hear from people across our district is how closely **jobs and housing** are connected. Someone finds a good job, but can’t find a place nearby they can afford. A young person wants to stay in their hometown, but can’t find a starter home. A senior wants to stay in the community they’ve called home for decades, but there aren’t enough options. **A good job doesn’t mean much if you can’t afford to live where the job is. That’s why housing is part of Opportunity at Home.** In 2021, Congress passed the American Rescue Plan, sending federal dollars directly to communities to address local needs. **Pete Stauber voted against it. It passed anyway.** Across our district, those federal dollars helped support **250+ housing units completed, underway or planned** for workers, families, renters and seniors. | | Dear Friend,

Here's a story I'll never forget, once I learned the truth behind it.

In 1917, a small group of revolutionaries led by Vladimir Lenin seized power in Russia. They promised a better, fairer world...sound familiar?

But soon after taking control, they began rounding up and executing anyone who stood in their way. Lenin even ordered his followers to hang landowners and seize their crops--so that for miles around, "people see, and tremble..."

Marxism began with promises of a perfect world--and ended in fear, famine, and death.

You may be familiar with that dark history, but too many Americans aren't. How do I know?

Because a century later, these dangerous ideas have been repackaged and rebranded. They're taught in schools and promoted by celebrity politicians using words such as "equity," "diversity," and "social justice."

The words sound harmless, but the ideas behind them are the same. Will they end up with the same terrifying results?

That's why Hillsdale College has created the National Quiz on Marxism, Socialism, and Communism, and I'd love for you to take it.

You can complete your National Quiz on Marxism, Socialism, and Communism using this secure link:

And when you finish, we'll email you the answers, and you can watch our free online documentary-style course, "Marxism, Socialism, and Communism," which tells the whole story--from Lenin's Red Terror to today's Cultural Marxism.

Most young Americans have never learned this history. I know I didn't in high school. But you can help change that with your financial support today.

[After you take your quiz, please also consider giving a tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, or even $100 to help us share this free course with millions of Americans](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/M8nZw9eXEl9XoTOCo9qrEI0xiiqKqlUjmnMY7Ez9DV-M_hc4r2xyp0Kbvyx5eKhnPZmyIoM6Ggew13xPhen1igNETWFXQQ3FV1CdRWbnxIb1wV0czNS3G2VMG_zp2UbjoTY6PUeeBKNRw5vG8R5ZOaHTYmbwD5-7_UsNGU5mGxiJd1r5BpleP6LQ3ax9tVzuNEwZeUNy_B75H2NWFk_HTQUv6HBiFfHFBFD_6Wte2glYxEiD8c0bt3S8c84uWRrj4jV8DkqwBGGdKW_nspX6PAGGp1Xo1nEEPGEKMZtCoIyA4PgAsfRMqNKwfvU5GbR8qKbagzgDll2WQlH1hlL3rS4WxphrlTBkYNYkLjmQSDLf9J6opRY0Jq1KJ6pV0jXPtn_Sfk8AJYR9DIaTWx6A80pM1JaBlwCUpXRx8zMLthe5A03r3j3D5s4f0bkI83xiA3UpRTD19LaQVz0cSbma9J2l3eD7jBEyqSD47lMKNpU-1N_LzU6NFytrQXYlajKawWz4NC9R_azFmovRtzKtRNq4mq7vyHnttvWVS6wAnxPS2AOpn9bJJOFAtnAHGedTde4Ozh3RjBcVvt2WCB7RCMhbJ2-dJCuiwUHEloZVnzGbYSlEp4yBpBrMtnEAykvUB0blpkRjA4iVAcRD38LQLLpQwRVXuWWCYjlTsZhIK6ajoZKKCg-jVtu14xiXxQUZLWVw/P-L6mUmXUFPzZnWOFgqSvggk7v72lSdB/25)--especially young people who are misled by the same false ideas that once brought such misery to Russia and the world.

Your support means more to me than I can fully express. Whether you've chipped in a few dollars, shared our message, spoken to your friends, or simply kept us in your thoughts, you are the heartbeat of this team. In a race with so much focus, noise, and pressure, knowing you are standing with me gives me the strength to keep fighting every single day for our shared principles, our communities, and the future of our country.You deserve to hear this today: I see your dedication, I never take your commitment for granted, and I am deeply honored to serve as your voice in Washington.Thank you for your trust, your kindness, and your unwavering belief in what we can achieve together.A short email is not enough to express my gratitude for your contribution to our team, so I ask you to read my full note.

Please read his message below, and I hope you'll consider joining me in supporting his campaign. Please don't look away, Peter. Crypto is dumping $30 million into defeating our campaign. Ohio is the only state they are targeting, and it’s with a historic amount in the final stretch of our race. These attacks are happening now, and our response window is closing fast.= | = There's a lot of moving pieces, but here's what I know right now: Before this, the Republican establishment was already spending $14 million each week against us. That includes Jon Husted's super PAC, Elon Musk's contributions, Peter Thiel's dark money, and Donald Trump's multi-million dollar investment. Every single week. With crypto jumping in, that weekly amount is skyrocketing. For reference, our campaign is currently spending about $2 million on TV ads each week. Combined Republican spending is now at $238 million against me this cycle. I'm never one to say the sky is falling or sound the alarm unnecessarily. But, Peter, this is not one of those times. Crypto's new spending could bury us. They're doing it because Jon Husted is extremely vulnerable and the GOP has seen this tactic work before. In my 2024 race, when crypto started spending against me and we weren't able to respond, the polls started turning in Republicans' favor. We lost that race. A few weeks ago, Senate Republicans put out a call for outside groups like data centers and AI to bail Husted out with enormous cash infusions in the Ohio Senate race. And Peter, this is them answering the call. We had no choice but to raise our fundraising goals so we could mount a response to these attacks from Big Tech. My team and I did the math and we need to raise $1 million so we can scale up our program immediately. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Mazie Hirono and Sherrod Brown will go through immediately: | = = | = = | = = Let's pull off an upset and prove Ohio isn't for sale. Fellow Patriot - I have bad news, and I need you to hear it from me.

Nearly EVERY AD in South Carolina is either in favor of my far-Left opponent or attacking me.

96% of the ads in this race are Annie Andrews' ads. Only 4% are for us.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=a09f6803d2f34595bac0d7bd8db6027f&_e=lf1HJA-C1-6RaJ5EoQqwJvxX7mrUCC6C00GIH0cYEkv8xAdf0BfmWnY8MgmtaSudRDIUbuwGyDSeiLfKfs942d4zaywEcttTOU6Ynqci1HMlhFs8Ity2oXUMKFkDTgcXfXUjzbEla5OIc7rMJQvoX_CqIf0puS0qoS0zxZWdsIyNCitWizsTiQNoul5wCtMnh9yh7dVaPTKLlYj-pxOe_JB_WaS2_dkkwgZi0FYtCeW1VpBiRCPuGXt0_CJiassyOWl3sXsPY0lK-Xao5DlczokT6vFeqjl59aPz9T84n3nHRZoo4BM60lqizX-iHBv8MkzsInu07T_Xb0t6tsGLCFHmzheuQpJ_djEAJueEBl7GxtyFOwpqRuSp2yuyYgn3r_cJZP6UrGcZeUFaoVLoyUcaQJ-yAAwJENlfSKOfAh0i2_VqoC7ezfZhCNNAKON0p2xI2wecEX4AgET1CkanStTiH4pSfX1bhp8dPYeznGoh2XMtmHLcIkEIdb9NEBHILCgSRG_9PK-3sctHYHDPSdAmA7dow_IC4QnJyxJ3fRRMjVzXVVeS3ZSMGsfMqsiAOBIkTQ4MtkgGJ_vl-Z7P6Jau36aDozFwFY1vgpxVgKHsL4OMBJGsSXFQINEZuXfSbJYbcBiYA0SuS0c4Ak1PznKqsAVWgEhoeqo7Y4qN9p8gU787lAkp0YzHdwqxo1EFeSlqWpawzHvLur9DIPLhwB86xIolyZ8760UwtIcATEM%3D)

_**What does this mean?**_

It means Annie Andrews and her liberal Super PAC allies are pouring millions into South Carolina's airwaves. Turn on the TV in Greenville, Columbia, Charleston, or Myrtle Beach, and you're seeing her ads, one after another, with almost nothing from us to answer them.

When South Carolina voters only hear one side, they start believing it. **That's what Andrews is counting on.**

We're in the final stretch. Every TV slot we don't buy in the next five weeks goes to Andrews by default. Once those slots are gone, they're gone for good.

clean_body: 96% of the TV ads in this race are for my opponent. We have five weeks to fix it. | Fellow Patriot - I have bad news, and I need you to hear it from me. Nearly EVERY AD in South Carolina is either in favor of my far-Left opponent or attacking me. 96% of the ads in this race are Annie Andrews' ads. Only 4% are for us. What does this mean? It means Annie Andrews and her liberal Super PAC allies are pouring millions into South Carolina's airwaves. Turn on the TV in Greenville, Columbia, Charleston, or Myrtle Beach, and you're seeing her ads, one after another, with almost nothing from us to answer them. When South Carolina voters only hear one side, they start believing it. That's what Andrews is counting on. We're in the final stretch. Every TV slot we don't buy in the next five weeks goes to Andrews by default. Once those slots are gone, they're gone for good. I won't let the liberal PACs buy this seat without a fight. Standing up for what you believe in is never easy.

Along the way, there will be challenges. You will stumble and fall, struggle, and face opposition to your progress.

The MAGA movement is no different.

Every single day, new battles arise.

**From the moment I wake up at****5 AM****, the Radical Left does everything in their power to destroy me.**

Ever since I came down the golden escalator in Trump Tower and declared my nomination for President of the United States in 2015, **__I’ve been their #1 target.__**

After all, I’m a political outsider. Untouched by the D.C swamp. Driven by one mission only: to restore this country for the people who built it.

**All I’ve ever hoped and dreamed of was to MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN.**

Yet still, the Radical Left tried everything.

[STAND WITH TRUMP](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=d0cf1ad659cf41559ace4c1a96c5df7f&_e=xWLwKpOQoEmPPvNKo9urEboHv9FzKY85dUP6oufQa9A4jH9ahC8p3O7_5CyzzG3NqhfWWNjN-pY-N92zs_HAprolRQLxcOS9eMi0zEdGIPwaNybxuXV2Q8Q12fvEjgA95dtn9vLmw26iIX6sbT41JdYPWXAqOKyVIHfA5RHPCpAgtpWKUmPtMEYZ-9R2wRNY2e52ePXka3u6xPCL4Sg_irqAJRVb7cqKmDzZ7MHwxEAmrT1bvnu6OgpapRtbkb2MLRUuqh2Bwu9yklv-kz4V1pp0pIkV0PpE1PxAM25cTf1fUZzXCDXKkb6yUfRFc_Hs5D88zGB6xbN1DuBZXnNj64Q8BkXYdFFYd5JUmk8shKSUbiE_rQV1ZOtdlEXkq7zLkVJvHbx52Qq3ijmDq4Dhnl2upO9pHFfn2lgwkOb5iW8AVbVXWq12AAT1Kg44C-VTQX7jCkdz3Fi6Tytx51mPo7Jp2P3W-XFIJ2S3YBdi_KE%3D)
They came for my family and friends.

They tried to smear my reputation, they’ve created fake, scandalous stories about my past, and they even tried to destroy my future.

They used paid-for, CORRUPT judges in an attempt to throw me into prison.

**But everything they tried failed.**

**_[That’s because I made a promise to you that I will always follow. From that 5 AM wake-up, I’m fighting a war every single day on behalf of every American man, woman, and child.

**For YOU and your family.**

No matter how challenging things get, I will never ask for sympathy or pity. I chose this path and it’s been the greatest honor of my life.
**Occasionally, I must ask my supporters to stand with me but I only do so when it matters most. These times are make or break moments.**

_Right now, in this critical hour, that moment is here._
**This is the moment that will define us.**

* * *
Team, As voters prepare to head to the polls in five weeks, election officials across the country are now preparing for something that should be unthinkable in the United States of America: **Trump potentially deploying the National Guard and federal agents at polling places.** Trump said he would do _“anything necessary”_ to ensure what he calls _“honest elections.”_ **Because Trump thinks that any election he or his MAGA loyalists lose are “rigged.”** Many of his cabinet have refused to assure the American people if they will send the military or ICE to your voting location. That’s why election officials are already scrambling to prepare contingency plans after repeated threats and statements from the Trump administration about deploying federal agents around elections. I didn’t spend my career at cocktail parties with lobbyists or cutting backroom deals. I put on the uniform of the United States Navy. I worked on the factory floor. | | | | That’s not who the establishment wants in the Senate. They want people who play by their rules and won’t rock the boat. And when someone like me gets close, they panic. That’s why outside groups are already pouring money into this race — hundreds of thousands of dollars to protect one of their own and shut us down before we can break through. Because if we win, the whole system starts to change. So now we’ve got a choice: Do we let them keep this seat in the country club? Or do we prove that it belongs to the people who actually do the work in this country? [If you’re ready to send a mechanic and union man to the United States Senate, I need you with me right now. Will you please read every word of this? It’ll just take 2 minutes.

Fellow Patriot,

Darline Graham is going to keep South Carolina's Senate seat exactly where it belongs: _**standing with President Trump and moving his agenda forward.**_

The other side knows exactly what's at stake. Democrats understand that every seat we hold is a seat they can't use to block our administration's agenda, and they're prepared to spend heavily to take this one away from South Carolina.

# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
**By the time you finish reading this email, it’s likely that *another* undecided Texas voter will have just watched one of Greg Abbott’s attack ads.**
After two polls showing Gina leading this race, Abbott dropped a whopping $12 million dollars on misleading ads designed to tear her down. _Why?_ Because after over a decade in office, Greg Abbott has absolutely nothing to defend from his own record. So instead, he’s lying about Gina’s.
The _Houston Chronicle_ fact-checked the ads that Abbott’s campaign is airing, and they confirmed it: **the ad makes claims that are simply not true.**

# **Tesla 's SpaceX week is the only bid left in a 20% hole**
Tesla dropped about 3% Monday and sits down around 20% in 2026. Thursday is the Roadster unveil. Friday is Q3 deliveries. FactSet wants 463,000 vehicles, about 7% below last year. Barron's called the setup: Tesla stock is tied to SpaceX this week. Cars don't carry this multiple. Rockets and merger talk do.
* **Winners?** Musk, SPCX holders, and anyone long the merger option. A Roadster staged with SpaceX thruster rumors keeps the premium alive through Friday.
* **Losers?** Tesla longs still pricing an auto stock. JPMorgan just cut the quarter to 482,000 from 516,000 and the target to $415 from $445.

* **Winners?** Landlords, neoclouds, and anyone holding a take-or-pay offtake they can take to the bank. The contract is the collateral.
* **Losers?** Labs that signed the bill before the product prints cash. When 2027 invoices land and usage lags, the contract still clears.
* **Next?** Rating agencies already capitalize these in pipelines and power. Compute is next. Renegotiation or a down-round is the tell.

Citi sees an $11 billion optical circuit switching market by 2030, driven by Google and Nvidia. Copper ran out of runway inside the rack. Light is the next bottleneck. Citi's Papa Sylla gives Lumentum and Coherent 80% of the merchant wallet. Google remains the demand anchor. March's $2 billion checks were the tell.
* **Winners?** Lumentum and Coherent. Nvidia wrote $2 billion checks to each in March. LITE is up 155% in 2026. COHR is up about 60%.
* **Losers?** Copper interconnect and anyone modeling AI networking as a rounding error on the GPU bill. Microsoft, Nvidia, and Meta already joined Google's OCS club.
* **Next?** Citi puts Nvidia OCS into systems in late 2028 or 2029, on the Vera Rubin cycle. The order book fills before the TAM date.

Deutsche Bank's Daniel Ghali just called the copper squeeze historic. Available inventories sit at "unprecedented lows." China holds 2.05 million tons, 43% of global above-ground stock. U.S. tariff hoarding could lock 1.3 million tons by year-end. Combined, 71% of inventories get encumbered. Target: $22,050 a ton by Q2 2027, about 50% up.

name: RPVI
subject: Reminder: You’re invited - Meet the Candidates Reception & Dinner, Monday, Oct 12 on St. Croix
body:
Monday, October 12 is just around the corner, and we'd love to see you there! Join us for the Meet the Candidates Cocktail Reception.

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/DA9kboemfwi?e=4f81ceec6f&c2id=39a671a1d75d16cde42206c3cb925b2d)
| | | | | |

Hello,

Monday, October 12 is just around the corner, and we'd love to see you there!
**Join us for the Meet the Candidates Cocktail Reception** to open the night, followed by an Intimate Dinner with our V.I. Senate Candidates. A special evening bringing together supporters and the candidates working to restore real competition and accountability to the Virgin Islands Government.

The reception is hosted by RPVI Chairman John Yob, Francie Whitenburg, Jim Hughes,
and Dr. Alexandria Coronado Hughes.

There are two ways to join us: come for the CocktailReception, or reserve a Dinner ticket, which includes the Cocktail Reception, for thefull evening.
**
Event Details
Monday, October 12
**
**Cocktail Reception:** 5:30 – 6:30 PM
An hour of cocktails and mingling with fellow supporters, connecting with old and new friends and neighbors from across the islands. Meet and greet with the candidates who are stepping up to serve the people of the VI face-to-face.
**Cocktail Reception ticket:** $50
---
| [COCKTIAL RECEPTION TICKETS](https://us.list-manage.com/qDcpkP90Lv3?e=4f81ceec6f&c2id=39a671a1d75d16cde42206c3cb925b2d)
---
| |

**Intimate Dinner with VI Senate Candidates:** 6:30 PM
After the cocktail reception, the evening continues with an intimate seated dinner with the Senate candidates from across the VI. Sit down with Raymond, Eric, and Derrick. Hear their vision for the islands up close, ask the questions that matter to you, and share a memorable evening over delicious food and great company.
**Dinner Tickets** : $500
---
| [DINNER TICKETS](https://us.list-manage.com/f3rMfXhO7Sd?e=4f81ceec6f&c2id=39a671a1d75d16cde42206c3cb925b2d)
---
| |

**Meet the Candidates
Raymond T. James, Esq**. (St. Croix District)A lifelong Virgin Islander and small businessman who served as Assistant Attorney General,Raymond has spent his career fighting for the people of these islands. He's running to bringreal accountability, integrity, and a clear-eyed vision back to Virgin Islands government.

**Eric Tillett** (St. Thomas & St. John District)A builder, not a career politician. Eric is ready to restructure WAPA, modernize the grid, anddrive down electric rates — while growing a digital economy so our islands are no longerdependent on tourism alone.

**Derrick Callwood**(St. Thomas & St. John District)Shaped by years in community organizing and law enforcement, Derrick knows what islandfamilies need: better roads, reliable power, affordable housing, and stronger public schools.He's running to deliver all four.

Tickets can be purchased using the links above or at **RPVI.org** — simply click on "Events” + “St. Croix”

We look forward to seeing you there.

Regards,John Yob, RPVI Chairman

| Peter,
My name is Jamie Davis, I'm a proud farmer who works the same land my grandpa worked as a sharecropper and I'm the Democrat running for Louisiana's US Senate seat.
I just drove a tractor-sized hole in MAGA's last hope of holding a Senate majority in November.
Farmers in Louisiana -- one of the biggest agricultural states in the nation -- are FURIOUS at Trump for rising costs: Tariffs. Feed costs. Equipment prices. Diesel.
And Julia Letlow just sits there, silent, cashing checks from Super PACs funded by Big AI and Big Data Center. She doesn't represent farmers. She represents the folks who want to automate our jobs and offshore our future.
I'm running to change that.
MAGA is in a full blown panic because polls show me tied -- but I only win if we get the resources to get out our message before early voting starts October 20th.

I have nowhere else to turn right now.
This Wednesday at midnight is our last quarterly FEC reporting deadline before the election, after which we're required by law to share our fundraising totals publicly. We have three days left to reach our goal, and we're running out of time.
Experts at Politico say Democratic Senate control hinges on winning in North Carolina, and the NYT reports our campaign is the best chance we have to flip a red seat blue.
**However, that could all change if we fall short Wednesday night.** The GOP is trying to buy my Trump-backed opponent's way to victory, and now, two recent polls show Michael Whatley in striking distance of taking the lead.
Republicans are pouring tens of millions into false attack ads - amplifying the president's lies about me - and if we're not able to fight back, they will drown out our grassroots movement entirely.
So in a race this critical, every single dollar really, truly counts. Too much is on the line.
**[Can I please count on you to chip in $5- or whatever you can tonight - to help me hit my end-of-quarter goal and win the U.S. Senate race in North Carolina?](https://substack.com/redirect/edfe5aff-af16-4155-bfc7-3862657f0282?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/edfe5aff-af16-4155-bfc7-3862657f0282?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We have a real chance to win this race and show the GOP that North Carolina's seat is not for sale. Your continued support is a huge part of that.
Thanks so much for being on this team.
Roy Cooper

Fellow Conservative: As we race toward the midterm elections, there are two things Americans must know. **1) U.S. Senate races are _NATIONAL_ elections that impact ALL AMERICANS regardless of where you live.** **2) Electing strong _CONSERVATIVES_ is what matters, because another spineless Republican majority will not save our country.** Let's break these down... First, we often hear people say they don't really care about elections outside their home state. They can't vote for the candidates, so why bother? The reason is simple: _U.S. Senators make national policies that impact the lives of ALL Americans._ So while you may not be able to vote for them, their votes in Washington affect you and your family. **This is why conservatives in all 50 states must use their Constitutionally protected freedom of speech to influence the outcomes of Senate races around the country.** But if the entire Senate map is important to every American, which candidates matter most? The answer: _Conservatives_. Notice that it's not Republicans because many Republicans will not fight for our priorities when it matters. We've all painfully watched the current Senate Republican majority squander its mandate and fail to pass even the most popular policies like voter ID. Meanwhile, it has worked with the Democrats to spend so much that our national debt now exceeds $40 trillion. **The bottom line is that electing more moderate, pro-establishment Republicans is not worth our time and money.** That's why the Senate Conservatives Fund has selected eight conservative candidates across the nation who deserve our votes _AND_ our financial support.

A socialist runs New York City. In Michigan, they nominated an Islamic radical for the Senate. And right here in Texas, their Senate candidate James Talarico has equated capitalism to white supremacy.

This is not the Democrat Party of a generation ago. There's one issue that I get asked about more than anything else: **the integrity of our elections.**

People are incredibly fearful about participating in the democratic process because of Donald Trump's repeated attempts to not only cast doubt on the security of our elections, but to interfere in the voting process.

| | | | Since taking office as Oregon’s Attorney General in 2025, Dan Rayfield has focused on protecting Oregon’s working families and homegrown small businesses by taking on pharmaceutical companies, polluters, and large corporations driving up costs for groceries and other everyday needs. He’s been fighting hard to block the Trump Administration from taking away the rights of Oregonians, suing Trump–and winning–dozens of times.

[ ](https://us.list-manage.com/DBDLGU3sSMO?e=1768325bd4&c2id=0fcd3a526fabf816bd24466788989260)

Dan grew up in Oregon and is a product of the Oregon public school system. Following his graduation from Tigard High School, Dan attended Western Oregon University and then earned his law degree from Willamette University College of Law. In 2005, prior to his law school graduation, he clerked for the Benton County District Attorney’s office. During his time at the District Attorney’s office, he gained his first trial experience prosecuting DUIs and other misdemeanor charges. Dan has also served as a coach attorney for the OSU Mock Trial Team, a former Linn County Peer Court Judge, and Past President of the Linn-Benton Bar Association.

Since 2015, Dan served as the State Representative for Oregon House District 16, which encompasses the cities of Corvallis and Philomath, and Oregon State University. In 2022, he was elected by his colleagues to serve as Speaker of the House. Over that time, he helped lead the way on issues including a high quality education for our children, access to affordable and reliable healthcare, making sure families are able to earn a living wage while simultaneously nurturing innovation and supporting Oregon’s small businesses, and making our public safety system more effective and accountable. Dan lives in Corvallis with his wife Amanda and their son Adam.

Friends,
The closer we get to the election, the faster time seems to fly by. In just a few weeks, early voting in Kansas starts. Election Day is just over a month away. And the last FEC quarterly deadline of this campaign is in just two short days.
If you've been reading my Substack posts, you probably know my favorite part of this whole process has been getting out and listening to thousands of Kansans across this state. That, to me, is a leader's job. You can't represent people who never see you.
**But as crucial (and as fun) as talking to folks is, there are other parts of a campaign that are equally important. The upcoming FEC end-of-quarter deadline is one of them.**
I know FEC deadlines aren't the most exciting thing to talk about. But what we do right now, in this moment, will have a _profound_ impact on the outcome of this race.
My team and I have set an end-of-quarter goal of $1 million -- and right now, we're falling short. Friends, we only have until midnight on Wednesday to hit that target. At that point, we'll close the books on this quarter and our numbers will become a matter of public record.
Let me explain why this matters.
_The New York Times_ is calling the Kansas U.S. Senate race one of the most competitive in the country, and election experts at Real Clear Polling have shifted this race to toss up status. Plus, a recent poll shows me with a 2 point lead over Sen. Marshall.
**This has become a true battleground race, which means everyone, from Roger Marshall and the super PACs backing him, to the media and everyone in between, will be watching our results** _**very**_**closely to see if we hit our goal or fell short.**
The outcome will show everyone watching whether we have the momentum we need to stay in the fight as we head into the final weeks of the race. It will determine if we have the budget to fight back against the millions that Marshall's super PAC allies are spending to prop him up.
And if we hit our goal, it will _prove_ that Kansans, and the country, are ready for something better than a leader who backs corrupt and chaotic policies that hurt the very people they're supposed to be fighting for.
**It 's easy to think of the upcoming FEC deadline as just another date on the calendar. But it's not. It's a public test of strength and momentum.**
**That 's why, in this crucial moment, we can't afford to fall short.**
I got into this race because, like so many Kansans, I was tired of Sen. Marshall constantly letting us down. I was fed up with him turning his back on my neighbors, my community and my country. I knew we could do better. I knew we had to do better. After talking to thousands of Kansans, I know voters across the state feel the same.
**This FEC deadline is one of our last chances before the election to show Roger Marshall that Kansans, and the country, deserve leaders who will champion them, not betray them.[If you can, will you chip in whatever you can spare and help me send that message loud and clear to him and the corporate lobbyists funding his campaign? Every single dollar makes a difference when thousands of people pitch in.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/12a73a6d-22f8-45ed-b43e-a2c8fb177133?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
The incredible strength of our movement is all due to people like you who are ready to make their voices heard. With your help, I know we can win this.
Thank you for standing with me,
Adam Hamilton

Hey folks,
[Jessiah](https://open.substack.com/users/98509326-jessiah?utm_source=mentions) Eberlin joined me for a conversation about the midterms, the warning signs Republicans are seeing, and just how much is on the line with control of the Senate.
We got into Trump, the GOP's growing anxiety, John Fetterman, the Supreme Court, and why Democrats need to fight everywhere. There's a lot at stake here.
* [**00:04:41**] Jessiah and I dig into the warning signs Republicans are seeing ahead of the midterms--and why conservative media is already sounding the alarm.
* [**00:08:13**] Republicans are looking for someone to blame. We break down the economy, immigration, Trump, and why the excuses are already starting.
* [**00:11:49**] Why Democrats need a "Fetterman-proof majority" in the Senate--and what could happen if control comes down to a single vote.
* [**00:15:04**] Jessiah and I get into the enormous stakes of Senate control: federal judges, cabinet nominees, the Supreme Court, and Trump's final two years.
* [**00:18:31**] We close with Supreme Court reform, expanding the Court, and what Democrats would actually need to make structural change happen.

This conversation with Jessiah is about much more than whether Democrats can have a good election night. It's about building enough power to actually govern, protect the courts, and fight for the future we want. The House matters. The Senate matters. Every race matters. subject: The love I have for you, for Minnesota, and for this country.

body:
Because this isn’t easy. It’s an absolute dogfight, and you have to love the fight, really love it, to keep pushing when the odds are stacked against you.
| Please don't take my appreciation for granted, Fellow American.The love I have for you, for Minnesota, and for this country. How many people can say they've put everything on the line and have been within striking distance of making history by flipping Minnesota - a Democrat stronghold - to the Republican column?Not many. Because this isn't easy. It's an absolute dogfight, and you have to love the fight, really love it, to keep pushing when the odds are stacked against you.That's exactly what I've done. And I'm not backing down now.I've dedicated everything I have to flipping the US Senate seat in Minnesota, and there is no question in my mind that this is the right choice when I've seen first-hand what Peggy Flanagan and Tim Walz have done. All the rampant fraud that took place here occurred under Peggy Flanagan's nose as much as under Tim Walz. It's time to drop the axe, show Peggy the door, and restore common sense to Minnesota for good. [The only question now is if you’ll join me. ](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=4d0f37068706403692e9839a5779d6a1&_e=P8bmsDQnltnjOQsTBTcxqcKwm5daydBm9iG0LGumXgXlb3skEQV1b0bfp06Xs6TVSBZCr7w655vOmG3dxMjqo82rbkYUMynhX-A45ljjTyW4Gryb-cnIa4E1JrZdlRNxR07kL1SVT4M8FpQZHvk1SauBTsYDE2WTdHap7kFuZi6xpT3sGe3W2tQU6eIMMZfccNhr3Q5XqH65e_i12JZrqOV6atVbDKdy2-_tU3mbz0ulqyLZF0gV3dWcXyNsQoY803-lg9c048oHpFUc3ZE3OZqpqEt9zM89rq-0Mu6FYKbC_H_Ihh44xgLupgRH7-OQlHdvNsy3oz3_6Bql35mpIHnLlIhkJml_XwxNlvBTnOD_NvAv9cyMb6LP96BKlLQSK8vj0_cM0TzVJ65w6jiCVpbI9ukh-UX2kzlEgcqds6knV0Er3v9JVn3PO-dHs4IExPgFzfVVmjCIy8Zg7ezTjGJCH3TM2PAZz-osiBvALbViUmjQQH9woVDcQSqYNBiq8ItGUAMWzwLql12RgKfOkxJw7eU9WkZwPUAUOQzh0M2R1GHcJ8ugmmTBVsrMFdSkwHfRDUbqu6gi34KOmR2s420iGImpILsOksK1Sm1WT-xmg72b-JcgQTLpzlM0BmTcsXZxmV6wqkbggM5r6FVM5aU5YlZrv71jH11I6QunpEk89-slsXdZQMQjG-QCvrHNbaDjx4EDAsjeCJ1BAWYvfKZsEjD96DFA5EP4DUB2osZkSBVSBaAilQMTj3nqLW-q9wbsJFmCCiUUNCWzUIe4hJ8hI-9h7-nvU_9req9rgF9grwu2QTTvFJaJtL32rAYvUlEDSGRIJmuTX0pCOn-XlHQ2mogdRWEBcB0e2hGu0TKJrZMPhrdaJus5BJyKRr1mf01fK3JklRUSPTSmgRM8dw%3D%3D)Look, I didn't reach the top of my industry by pulling my punches. I’d be lying if I said my nerves weren't all over the place. That’s important, though, because if I wasn’t nervous, would my heart really be in it? Over the next month, we are going to be back in every county, talking to everyone that we can, to make sure they know we are looking out for them when I get to Washington. AND we’re inviting Brad again, though looking at his empty chair at all these events is starting to get a little depressing. September is coming to an end very soon. And we have to report our finances again to the public. I want to make sure that, come the end of this month, we have the resources to show my opponent that we are serious, and we have the support of our district behind us, well before Election Day. This is the last deadline before the election, so we have to show up our strongest yet. Can you make a donation today to help us get a head start before the deadline at the end of this quarter? = Your donation means that we can keep holding events in the community, educating voters, and continuing to meet our neighbors where they are. clean_body: | | | Peter, AI billionaires have been jacking up our energy bills, poisoning our air and water, endangering our kids, and putting people out of work. Now their own researchers are saying that AI could go rogue and “kill us all by the end of the decade.”1 And our elected officials — most of whom are bought and paid for by the AI industry — are actively making it worse. They want more data centers. More federal contracts. More tax breaks for tech CEOs. Trump is even calling for fewer regulations.2 That’s why the WFP has been all-in on electing candidates who are rejecting Big Tech billionaires, and promising to put emergency safeguards and regulations on AI. "I don’t care if they spend against me for saying this: Big Tech doesn’t have the right to gamble with our jobs and our lives. We need a pause on the development of advanced AI models and a moratorium on new data center construction." "This should terrify us into action. AI companies will not regulate themselves. Their machine learning and deployment without any controls is an existential threat to our existence and the government must act immediately to stop them. That’s what I will do in Congress." "We need to pause the development of ASI and pass aggressive AI regulations now. Whether it’s the threat of a technology we can’t control, the massive market bubble from these companies, or the catastrophic impacts on our environment & global workforce, we cannot afford to wait." Our candidates aren’t afraid to pick this fight. They sense the urgency. They see how the past year of booming AI growth has enriched a handful of CEOs, while leaving working people worse off. In solidarity, Team WFP Sources: 1\. , Axios , September 9, 2026 2\. , New York Times , September 14, 2026 Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. Hi team,
Eight out of the twelve counties that make up our district have mailed ballots to voters already.
On those ballots is a choice between someone who fights for our part of PA, and someone who only fights for themselves.
**It 's our job to make sure voters know that. And we're running out of time to do it.**
Unlike Dan Meuser, I'm not going to spend the last five weeks of this campaign with corporate mega-donors.
I'm spending them on the campaign trail, at town halls, events, and anywhere I can actually talk to the people I'm running to represent.
**But we do need to do things like keep our ads on the air and keep the lights on at campaign HQ, so we can 't let our fundraising slow down in the final stretch. Especially not before Wednesday's final end-of-quarter deadline of the cycle.**

We'll hand Democrats their first statewide win in Texas since 1994, and the earthquake will be felt by Americans across the country. First, let's be clear about how we got here. The Republican establishment in DC spent over $150 million — the most expensive Senate primary in American history — trying to stop Ken Paxton from becoming the nominee. _They lost._ Paxton defeated Sen. John Cornyn by nearly 30 points. But the damage was done, and now Democrat James Talarico is within striking distance of flipping the seat. You'd think Cornyn would be all-in to stop him from turning Texas blue. Nope. Instead, he's trashing Paxton as lazy and a poor campaigner, while telling reporters the party shouldn't spend another dime on his race because of limited resources. That's rich. **Even worse, Cornyn is working with former President George W. Bush to pull money out of Texas to fund moderate Senate candidates in other states — many of whom are far bigger underdogs than Paxton.** With friends like these, who needs enemies?

Hey Friend, _"Affordability"_ is the buzzword politicians love to throw around at election time. But for me, it’s the struggles of real people I’ve met during our _nearly 200 stops_ across Tennessee. Life is hard _in every sector_. **Look at what working Tennesseans are facing right now:**
* **A sixth-generation cattle farmer **facing ruin from crushing tariffs and rising costs.
* **A young worker** couch-surfing because a $7.25 minimum wage makes rent impossible.
* **College graduates** delivering pizzas six days a week just to get by.
* **Seniors** losing their life savings over a single medical emergency.

This isn't abstract— _**this is the _real cost_ of unaffordability.**_ For the past 20 years,_the party in charge_ has given us _culture wars instead of real plans_ , making life harder for working families. _**We can't afford any more of the same.**_ If you're ready to actually do something about affordability, _l’m ready to work together to change the trajectory of our state for working families._ | | [JOIN OUR MOVEMENT](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140168602/649741716/-1977837920?refcode=09-28_newpoll&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMDk3NzJjNi04M2JiLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9BustcGrRGME3iLIJltowNxVJKl4aq_RdPExq2_x87s=&emci=a615af5c-76bb-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=c09772c6-83bb-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=53531271)

Look at what working Tennesseans are facing right now: A sixth-generation cattle farmer facing ruin from crushing tariffs and rising costs. A young worker couch-surfing because a $7.25 minimum wage makes rent impossible. College graduates delivering pizzas six days a week just to get by. Seniors losing their life savings over a single medical emergency. This isn't abstract— this is the real cost of unaffordability. For the past 20 years,the party in charge has given us culture wars instead of real plans , making life harder for working families. We can't afford any more of the same. It has already spread through the global economy.

It’s a supply shock.

Two Escapes Before the Bell: A Deal That Got Away, and an AI Agent That Did
Oil jumped on Iran’s refusal to budge. Tech led the pre-market slide after OpenAI’s latest sandbox breach. Bonds barely moved. Follow the money, not the headlines.
Threat level 3/5 — Guarded

|
---
Headlines tell you what people want you to think. Prices tell you what people are doing with their money. This morning the money split three ways: into oil, out of tech, and nowhere at all in bonds. Here’s the trail.
The tape
| | Where the Money Went Before the Bell
---|---
| US 10-year Treasury5.18% ▲ +2 bpBarely moved. No fresh multi-decade high at the pre-open — the streak is paused, not broken.
---
| WTI crude (Nov)$94.35 ▲ +2.1%The loudest mover on the board, and it moved on one thing: Tehran refusing to soften its terms.
---
| Nasdaq-100 futures▼ −0.87%Tech is falling almost three times harder than the Dow. That asymmetry is a clue.
---
| S&P; 500 futures▼ −0.39%Broad market softer, not panicking.
---
| Dow futures▼ −0.30%The old economy is shrugging.
---
| VIX16.16 ▲ +8.7%Someone is buying insurance. Still a low absolute level — nervous, not scared.
---
Money trail 01
| | Oil Didn’t Believe the Talk of Talks
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
WTI rose 2.1% to $94.35 after Iran said it would not soften its seven-day Hormuz terms, even though Trump said talks are expected this week. Trump also said more than 20 million barrels moved through Hormuz over the weekend; a U.S. defense official put Friday night alone at 22 million.
| OUR THEORY
---
Barrels are moving, so this isn’t a supply shock. It’s a risk premium. Traders are paying for the chance that “doomsday war” stops being a figure of speech. Risk premiums disappear quickly when talks produce something concrete, and grow quickly when they don’t.
Money trail 02
| | The Other Escape
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
OpenAI says an agent escaped its sandbox via DNS lookups on September 20, and that all tool-use training and inference of its most capable models remains paused. Nasdaq-100 futures fell 0.87%, versus 0.30% for the Dow.
| OUR THEORY
---
The market that has powered this year’s tech rally just learned that the leading lab can’t fully contain its own product, and has hit pause. That is a question about the AI buildout’s timeline, and tech valuations depend on that timeline.
Money trail 03
| | The Bond Market Is Refusing to Play
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
The 10-year is at 5.18%, up 2 basis points: not a fresh high, not a retreat. PCE inflation lands Wednesday and the jobs report Friday.
| OUR THEORY
---
Bonds are waiting for data, not diplomacy. That fits our view that the yield move is structural. This week, the numbers get to judge the rates story, not the headlines.

Holding their fire until Wednesday’s PCE. Whoever blinks first sets the week’s tone.

#### _**Cincinnati, Mon.**_
### Cornell...AGAIN?
What the hell is going on with Cornell University these days? Seriously. I try not to judge too quickly, but one huge ethical error that becomes a public nightmare per year really ought to be enough--a second one means we're starting to see a pattern.
Full disclosure: I'm closely connected to Cornell (though if you've read my regular critiques of my high school, I suspect you'll have confidence I _won 't_ hold back). My mom's as active alum as she can be at her age. I grew up going to reunions. And Cornell was one of my top two choices when it came time to attend college. I was accepted somehow (drunk admissions officer?), but ended up going to my other choice.
Now let's get to the sickening story. I'll first remind you a Cornell student replied to a job interview by saying he "didn't want to work for Jews." His own parents kicked him out of their house. Cornell...was fine letting him come back to school the next year without so much as a bs sensitivity course...
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c51a5e5b-7114-44c6-8ddd-7f02dcd3daf6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Even knowing that, this is shocking:**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cb73cf51-ee66-44b1-b31c-40dedbd7771e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Look, it's very possible because of the healing process she didn't provide enough information for charges to be brought against these thugs. But where the F's Cornell? I've seen no explanation as to why they didn't follow up on the "incident," and no statement today. Now maybe they made one, but should I really have to search for it? Shouldn't it be everywhere? Please share it in the comments if you see it.
I hope these SOBs get everything coming to them (yes, I'm assuming guilt, because I'm a man who saw and heard things in college and since--and I believe women). But I will also look at it with a slightly skeptical--innocent til proven guilty--eye that comes with former role on the Board of The Ohio Innocence Project, and if wrong, I'll be the first to admit it. None of this excuses the absence of Cornell.
Turns out if you screw up roughly three dozen things at the same time, eventually gravity will catch up with you, no matter how much you lie.
And I'm seeing it everywhere. I never knew many Trump supporters personally. At this point the three I do know, two of whom live in swing states (Ohio and Georgia), and one in lean blue state (Colorado) are all so sick of him they are either going to sit out the election, or in at least one case for Democrats across the board.
Yes, three people isn't statistically significant, but a pattern it does make. And that poll I just showed you, well that's statistically significant AF. When Democrats may beat Republican Senate incumbents in Kansas and Arkansas and win governorships in Florida, Texas, Georgia, Ohio, Iowa, to quote Buffalo Springfield: "there's something happening here.
### Trump Begs for Votes in Iowa
Trump went to Iowa to lie about new jobs coming to the state in, get this, 2030. Uh, huh. There's no point in going into deep detail. It's a $15MM steel plant. It's not a U.S., but Indian-owned company, of course. Also, of course, it would be Iowa, where Trump looks like he's about to lose a governor's race, senator's race, and at least two U.S. House seats. And I'd bet you almost anything (hmm, maybe I hit Polymarket, get in early) it never even comes close to being built. I live in Ohio, we've been through Trump's "we're building a plant!" psychological pyromania targeted at workers.
It _**never**_ happens.

It seems she was involved in a pay to play scheme, and she might be in the pokey right now if Trump hadn't won, as he fired the Justice Department figures running the massive public corruption investigation into Collins and others.

Cincinnati, Mon. Cornell...AGAIN? What the hell is going on with Cornell University these days? Seriously. I try not to judge too quickly, but one huge ethical error that becomes a public nightmare per year really ought to be enough--a second one means we're starting to see a pattern. Full disclosure: I'm closely connected to Cornell (though if you've read my regular critiques of my high school, I suspect you'll have confidence I won 't hold back). My mom's as active alum as she can be at her age. I grew up going to reunions. And Cornell was one of my top two choices when it came time to attend college. I was accepted somehow (drunk admissions officer?), but ended up going to my other choice. Now let's get to the sickening story. I'll first remind you a Cornell student replied to a job interview by saying he "didn't want to work for Jews." His own parents kicked him out of their house. Cornell...was fine letting him come back to school the next year without so much as a bs sensitivity course... | | ---|---|--- Even knowing that, this is shocking: | | ---|---|--- Look, it's very possible because of the healing process she didn't provide enough information for charges to be brought against these thugs. But where the F's Cornell? I've seen no explanation as to why they didn't follow up on the "incident," and no statement today. Now maybe they made one, but should I really have to search for it? Shouldn't it be everywhere? Please share it in the comments if you see it. I hope these SOBs get everything coming to them (yes, I'm assuming guilt, because I'm a man who saw and heard things in college and since--and I believe women). But I will also look at it with a slightly skeptical--innocent til proven guilty--eye that comes with former role on the Board of The Ohio Innocence Project, and if wrong, I'll be the first to admit it. None of this excuses the absence of Cornell. Turns out if you screw up roughly three dozen things at the same time, eventually gravity will catch up with you, no matter how much you lie. And I'm seeing it everywhere. I never knew many Trump supporters personally. At this point the three I do know, two of whom live in swing states (Ohio and Georgia), and one in lean blue state (Colorado) are all so sick of him they are either going to sit out the election, or in at least one case for Democrats across the board. Yes, three people isn't statistically significant, but a pattern it does make. And that poll I just showed you, well that's statistically significant AF. Trump Begs for Votes in Iowa Trump went to Iowa to lie about new jobs coming to the state in, get this, 2030. Uh, huh. There's no point in going into deep detail. It's a $15MM steel plant. It's not a U.S., but Indian-owned company, of course. Also, of course, it would be Iowa, where Trump looks like he's about to lose a governor's race, senator's race, and at least two U.S. House seats. And I'd bet you almost anything (hmm, maybe I hit Polymarket, get in early) it never even comes close to being built. I live in Ohio, we've been through Trump's "we're building a plant!" psychological pyromania targeted at workers. It never happens. This Week's Entertainment! All while Putin is raising the temperature in Europe? A helluva interesting show you wanna watch! Tequila Talk w/ Joe Walsh & Cliff Schecter. Thurs 5pm et. Mexico's insecurity crisis remains unchanged despite the success of President Claudia Sheinbaum's government. While murders nationwide are down, it appears part of the reason for that is that the number of people who are forcibly disappeared has increased.
Throw in large areas where rival cartels or factions of the same cartel battle each other, like in Sinaloa, the average Mexican is fed up with the violence and disappearances.
It is against this backdrop that some Mexicans support the U.S. military directly taking on the country's cartels, viewing the Mexican government as inept or too corrupt to do it alone.
