_**(Piece continues)**_
I spoke to some of these Mexicans during a recent memorial service for people who have gone missing, some as far back as 2007 and as recently as 2023. The event took place on the outskirts of Tijuana at a compound that was used by the cartel to dissolve victims so their bodies would never be found.
## _WATCH:_
[](https://substack.com/redirect/5f280018-70bb-4aa8-b353-5a9f48d51d9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"The Mexican government hides behind national sovereignty and the non-intervention of foreign governments. But from my point of view, if we have a problem, we must accept help," said Fernando Ceguera Flores, president of the Association United for the Disappeared of Baja California. "I do agree that there should be cooperation between countries to attack the scourge of drug trafficking and the missing persons issue together."
Another attendee, Maria Dolores Hernandez Loera, told me, "The way we are here in this country, we truly need to grab onto everything we can, whatever help it may be for us, because really, the government hasn't done much."
She continued, "I do believe we need help from other places to be able to fight these people because, unfortunately, they are taking our youth...My son was only 21 years old."
Hernandez Loera's son, Humberto, went missing in 2019 three months after arriving in Tijuana with his wife and infant daughter.
"They should already do something because here in Mexico, they don't. If [Trump] is going to start helping us tackle this issue I don't see it as a bad thing," said Claudia Lopez Ayala, who is looking for her son, Christopher Giovanni Lopez Lopez. Ayala's son went missing in September 2022.
The issue of the American military being used in Mexico is a touchy subject for our southern neighbors. Starting with the Mexican-American War, other military engagements, and the ongoing drug war, many other Mexicans are skeptical or downright adamant U.S. troops on their soil would be a disaster.
President Sheinbaum has made it clear she does not want U.S. military personnel operating in Mexico. Her stance is one that is not popular in Latin America anymore.
Recently, U.S. Marine Raiders and Army Green Berets conducted an operation with Ecuadorian police to arrest members of Jalisco New Generation Cartel (CJNG) who were working in Ecuador. Such missions could serve as a blueprint for U.S. troops to work with other Latin American countries to hit cartels where it hurts the most.
If these successes against criminal groups in different nations continues, it will be harder for Mexicans to not want the same thing to happen their home.

Peter, Before I ask if you can make a donation [to fuel the fair maps movement](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140171208/649749892/1548394306?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_RedrawsThatFlip_email_20260928-NDRC-Tier1-RedrawsThatFailed_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260928-NDRC-Tier1-RedrawsThatFailed_&utm_campaign=RedrawsThatFlip&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ5YTJlYzBmLThhYmItZjExMS1hNmE5LTAwMGQzYTU2ZDJmNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=JfnZUbNeHgn0w687D_10icxbkQL-qaorbmAhyStY7qY=), I want to talk about the proof that your support makes a meaningful difference. It starts with a basic fact, which as recently as a few months ago was far from a given: Democrats are poised to take back the House majority this fall — in spite of a full-court press from Donald Trump and his allies across the country to pass mid-decade gerrymanders across the country. The other side wanted a congressional map in which they literally could not lose, no matter what voters had to say about it. But they didn’t get their wish. They couldn’t manipulate the map everywhere they wanted to — because the fair maps movement had something to say about it:
* Redraws fell short in **Indiana, South Carolina, and Georgia** , where public pressure helped shut down efforts to rush through new gerrymanders.

* After **Missouri** passed its gerrymander, a citizen-led effort rallied to gather signatures to put it up for a vote. Now, thanks to the tenacious effort from that group and from the fair maps movement, the previous, fairer map is still in place, and voters will have a chance in November to reject the new gerrymander for good.

The work we do to organize volunteers and keep voters engaged, even when the odds are stacked against us, is a huge part of that story. Our political team is monitoring what is happening in each state every single day. Our mapping team is able to immediately spring into action to determine the potential impact of redraws so we can communicate that to key leaders and decision-makers. And supporters like you are quick to jump into the fights where we can make the greatest impact, making sure lawmakers know that they’ll be held accountable. This GOP power grab was unprecedented — but thanks to this team and your support, we weren’t caught flat-footed. We fought off a worst-case scenario. And it’s hard to overstate just how much that affects where this fight goes from here. But our political team reports that Republicans are already gearing up for new gerrymandering pushes in Mississippi and Georgia — and it could start in the days immediately following the midterms. That means we need to walk and chew gum for each of the next 38 days. clean_body: With your support, we kept Republicans from getting their cynical wish | Peter, Before I ask if you can make a donation =, I want to talk about the proof that your support makes a meaningful difference. It starts with a basic fact, which as recently as a few months ago was far from a given: Democrats are poised to take back the House majority this fall — in spite of a full-court press from Donald Trump and his allies across the country to pass mid-decade gerrymanders across the country. The other side wanted a congressional map in which they literally could not lose, no matter what voters had to say about it. But they didn’t get their wish. They couldn’t manipulate the map everywhere they wanted to — because the fair maps movement had something to say about it: Redraws fell short in Indiana, South Carolina, and Georgia , where public pressure helped shut down efforts to rush through new gerrymanders. After Missouri passed its gerrymander, a citizen-led effort rallied to gather signatures to put it up for a vote. Now, thanks to the tenacious effort from that group and from the fair maps movement, the previous, fairer map is still in place, and voters will have a chance in November to reject the new gerrymander for good. The work we do to organize volunteers and keep voters engaged, even when the odds are stacked against us, is a huge part of that story. Our political team is monitoring what is happening in each state every single day. Our mapping team is able to immediately spring into action to determine the potential impact of redraws so we can communicate that to key leaders and decision-makers. And supporters like you are quick to jump into the fights where we can make the greatest impact, making sure lawmakers know that they’ll be held accountable. This GOP power grab was unprecedented — but thanks to this team and your support, we weren’t caught flat-footed. We fought off a worst-case scenario. And it’s hard to overstate just how much that affects where this fight goes from here. But our political team reports that Republicans are already gearing up for new gerrymandering pushes in Mississippi and Georgia — and it could start in the days immediately following the midterms. | | Friend, In two days, my campaign closes the books on our final quarterly FEC deadline before Election Day. When that report goes public, Republicans will read it closely. They are watching this seat to see whether a last-minute push could help elect their far-right candidate. I have seen what they are willing to spend. In 2022, the Congressional Leadership Fund poured more than $4 million into this race, and we held the seat by fewer than 2,000 votes. The NRCC has put late money into this district before, and I fully expect them to try again. That is why this deadline matters so much. With 3 _6 days left until Election Day_ , families across Connecticut's 5th District are counting on us. They are being priced out of healthcare and housing. They are watching tariffs rise, tax cuts go to the wealthiest, and essential federal programs get cut. They deserve a representative who shows up and fights for them, and I intend to keep doing exactly that. But I cannot do it alone. body:
Judicial Watch announced that a federal judge in Washington, DC has ordered a status conference in its lawsuit against the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) for all records related to events on January 6, 2021, in the U.S. Capitol. The status conference is set for today, September 24.

subject: The Biden DOJ railroaded my husband
body:

---
Dear Fellow Patriot,
---
| | This is the photo of a good Christian man. A loving husband of almost 20 years, a supportive father of seven, and a dedicated law enforcement officer. I’m proud to call former Jal, New Mexico Police Officer Eddie Embly my husband – and I’m urgently asking you to help keep him from spending the next decade in federal prison. Please, allow me to explain...
---
| [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| | In July 2021, my husband responded to a call about a suspicious vehicle at a local truck stop. The driver was disoriented, sweating, unsteady, and acting erratically. And officers had to use a Taser to take him into custody. My husband had a limited role in the arrest – he helped move the suspect to the patrol car and transported him a short distance to the police station. Shortly after arriving at the station, the suspect became unresponsive and was pronounced dead. After investigating, the state medical examiner definitively ruled the cause of death as methamphetamine toxicity. **In other words, a meth overdose – a tragedy all too common here in New Mexico.**
---
| | So imagine our shock when over two years later, the Biden Department of Justice accused Eddie of “failing to intervene” and a “deliberate indifference to medical needs” – and charged him under a federal civil rights statute carrying up to 20 years in prison. We poured our lifesavings into Eddie’s defense expecting justice would prevail at trial and he’d soon be back on the job. But instead, the government blocked all evidence of the suspect’s meth overdose from the trial. **The jury found Eddie GUILTY – and he faces up to 20 years in prison**
---
| [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
[ **SUPPORT EDDIE!** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| | Now Eddie will miss our last child’s graduation in May 2026. He won’t get to walk our daughters down the aisle. And he’ll probably miss the birth of our 9th grandchild in July 2026 and future grandchildren that we’ve prayed for since the day our eldest child was born. With nowhere to turn, I turned to God and prayed like I’ve never prayed before... And God answered our prayers – in the form of a phone call from Jason Johnson with the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). For over 30 years, LELDF has supported hundreds of officers like Eddie who have been wrongly accused or convicted. This organization is run by policing experts like Jason, who reviewed all uses of deadly force for the Baltimore Police Department, Ronald Reagan’s Attorney General Ed Meese, and several retired FBI agents. [**And these experts believe in Eddie and have offered to pay for his appeal!**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) For the first time in months, I see a future with Eddie by my side enjoying our golden years. But LELDF doesn’t receive taxpayer funding or grants, and large gifts are few and far between. Instead, LELDF relies on kind-hearted strangers who respect our men and women in blue and want to help cops like Eddie who are unjustly convicted. Folks, I pray, like you. **[Will you help LELDF fight for Eddie by making a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, or more today?](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**
---
[ **DONATE** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
No matter how much you’re able to help, your donation will be put to immediate use helping LELDF support Eddie and a dozen other wrongly accused officers You see, I didn’t realize until Eddie’s nightmare unfolded that progressive prosecutors across the U.S. are still charging police officers with bogus crimes. I had thought that all ended when President Trump took office in 2016! But the reality is the prosecutorial war on cops is escalating at an unprecedented rate, and LELDF is currently supporting a record number of officers with at least X other cases expected to go to trial in 2026. **[That’s why I’m asking you to help LELDF fund Eddie’s appeal by making an urgent donation today.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** The appeal will cost approximately $175,000 – so whether you can give $35, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more – every gift will make a huge difference. But no matter how much you’re able to send in support of Eddie, please pray for us. I know firsthand the power of prayer. And I know with LELDF behind us and an army of prayer warriors beside us, Eddie will win his appeal and we can move on with our lives. From the very bottom of my heart, thank you.
---
With God’s blessings,
---
**Jennifer Embly**
---
[ **DONATE** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---

body:
This is voter suppression.
**Just weeks before Election Day, Texas Republicans shut down 92 polling locations in Tarrant County.**
Now voters will have to struggle with hours-long lines at the polls and chaos leading up to November 3rd.
This is voter suppression.
[](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260928_2_ak.MbOafT&refcode=em20260928-973&%3Bamount=5&t=2&akid=973%2E127862%2EcmIUTT)
This isn't an accident. This is all happening because voters delivered massive turnout in Tarrant County back in March, despite last-minute polling location closures, and now Republicans are making sure they’re cutting their voting options ahead of time.
When Republicans see people showing up for Democrats, they try to change the rules. These tactics fall hardest on Black, Latino, and working-class voters who can least afford to lose hours standing in line just to exercise their right to vote.
But we won’t let these suppression tactics intimidate us. We’re going to ensure voters in Tarrant County and across Texas show up to vote early and fight back against these voting suppression tactics.

Thank you,
Gina

| | |
---
| | | When your job, your privacy, and your children’s safety are on the line, “trust us” isn’t good enough. **Not from the companies building artificial intelligence. Not from the politicians responsible for holding them accountable.** I studied microbiology and economics, then worked as an economist for the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140172091/649752584/-1246315766?refcode=260928-mannysplit&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NjYwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZTMxNWY1My04ZGJiLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBn_BvfuVvjE05csN39QVC70knQtmyz80aBOpK36xgY=)
---
**That background taught me to look beyond what something promises and ask harder questions:** Who benefits? Who bears the risk? And who’s responsible when something goes wrong? That’s how I approach AI. [**Before I continue — if you think Congress needs more people with real science and economics backgrounds writing these rules instead of the companies profiting from them, chip in $10 right now to my campaign and Dr. Jasmine Clark and let's keep going.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140172092/649752585/-1246315766?refcode=260928-mannysplit&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NjYwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZTMxNWY1My04ZGJiLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBn_BvfuVvjE05csN39QVC70knQtmyz80aBOpK36xgY=)

I see the potential. But I also see why parents deserve safeguards before their child starts talking to an AI chatbot. Why workers deserve protections when AI threatens their job. Why someone who exposes a serious safety risk deserves protection, not retaliation. We shouldn’t have to choose between technological progress and protecting people. We should demand both. In Colorado, I helped lead the passage of landmark AI consumer protections. In Congress, I want to build on that work with independent safety reviews before major AI model releases, whistleblower protections, and real accountability when companies put people at risk. **These decisions are too important to leave entirely to the companies profiting from them. Families and workers deserve a voice in what happens next.** That’s the voice I’m running to bring to Congress. **[Will you chip in $10 to help me win this seat and fight for AI guardrails that put people first?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140172093/649752586/-1246315766?refcode=260928-mannysplit&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NjYwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZTMxNWY1My04ZGJiLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VBn_BvfuVvjE05csN39QVC70knQtmyz80aBOpK36xgY=)**

clean_body: | | | | | | When your job, your privacy, and your children’s safety are on the line, “trust us” isn’t good enough. Not from the companies building artificial intelligence. Not from the politicians responsible for holding them accountable. I studied microbiology and economics, then worked as an economist for the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers. = That background taught me to look beyond what something promises and ask harder questions: Who benefits? Who bears the risk? And who’s responsible when something goes wrong? That’s how I approach AI. = I see the potential. But I also see why parents deserve safeguards before their child starts talking to an AI chatbot. Why workers deserve protections when AI threatens their job. Why someone who exposes a serious safety risk deserves protection, not retaliation. We shouldn’t have to choose between technological progress and protecting people. We should demand both. In Colorado, I helped lead the passage of landmark AI consumer protections. In Congress, I want to build on that work with independent safety reviews before major AI model releases, whistleblower protections, and real accountability when companies put people at risk. These decisions are too important to leave entirely to the companies profiting from them. Families and workers deserve a voice in what happens next. That’s the voice I’m running to bring to Congress. = = Thank you,Manny Rutinel Democrat Nominee for CO-08 = | | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jasmine Clark for Georgia Jasmine Clark for Georgia 4370 Lawrenceville Hwy #96 Lilburn, GA 30048 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please .

Plants are stalling because workers with every legal right to be there are too terrified to show up. This is a region that processes about a fifth of this nation's grain-fed beef. The cattle industry itself is begging for mercy, and this is Trump's own base talking. The Texas Cattle Feeders Association joined its counterparts in Oklahoma and Kansas, all of them longtime backers of Trump and his allies, in a statement warning that the ICE raids are killing their industry. When Texas cattlemen publicly break with a Republican administration so loudly, our shot to FLIP TX-03 just went from possible flip to here for the taking. Our district is full of ranch country now, courtesy of the map Republicans drew, and those Texas families are absorbing a one-two punch from the administration they backed for years. First, Trump flooded the market with cheap Argentine imports, undercutting Texas ranchers before tens of thousands of pounds got recalled as unsafe. Now he is gutting the workforce that turns Texas cattle into Texas beef, and Kansas is a preview of what these raids do to a beef town. Processing costs climb from here, which means your grocery bill jumps again too. Keith Self voted for every dime of the ICE funding that 's powering these raids. Ask him about the ranchers or your beef prices, and he has nothing, because fear is the only product he sells. subject: My decision

body:
Here's the truth
Peter –
As I was having my coffee yesterday morning, I was thinking about my journey to this moment. I never imagined that I would be here today, representing the people of Virginia’s 7th district, and fighting for our future in Congress.
I’m a Jewish-Ukrainian immigrant whose family came to America to find hope like so many others, and I was proud to join the military and serve my country.
When my brother, Lt. Col. Alexander Vindman, heard President Trump’s infamous call with Ukraine, we knew our oath to defend our country and the Constitution required us to report the call up the chain of command.
Because we did not let Trump's abuse of his office stand, he was impeached — and his vengeance cost us our careers when we were fired in retaliation.
Back then, I never thought I would run for Congress. But in the years following, we saw Republicans go all-in on authoritarianism. And to this day, with Donald Trump in office, that threat exists. More than ever.
It started with the attempted coup of January 6th, Trump and his allies illegally meddling in fair elections, and the GOP rolling back our fundamental rights.
Now, it's the attacks against working people. The corruption. The stripping of healthcare away from millions of families. And another endless war in the Middle East risking the lives of our service members and raising costs here at home.
Throughout it all, I've stood my ground. I’ve fought for working families and been a voice for our service members. And I’ve even dared to hold Trump accountable again on the House floor, knowing I would face his vengeance once again. And to no one’s surprise, I did. He launched a sham investigation into me to kick me out of Congress.
But not for a second did I doubt my decisions, Peter. Why? Because we can’t sit by while our country is brought to its breaking point like this.
So when I heard the call to serve two years ago, I did what I always did. I answered it.
But the reality is that threat remains — and its not going anywhere as long as Trump’s minions in Congress continue to grant him unchecked power.
So now I am trying to continue my service in Congress. For you. For our democracy. And for the future of our republic.
But I cannot do this alone. I need your help to get across the finish line. The path to the House majority and putting a check on Trump’s power runs through VA-07, and we cannot fall behind on our fundraising if we want to have the resources we need to win this race.

I’ve been crunching the numbers, and with just two days left until our 3X Match Fund ends, **we’re still $207,000 away from hitting our $500,000 end-of-quarter goal.** To be honest, this has me a bit worried, Peter. Every week, somewhere over the Hindu Kush, a chartered jet noses into Kabul with roughly $40 million in American cash -- palletized, shrink-wrapped, and bound for a humanitarian pipeline that our own inspectors have spent five years documenting as the Taliban's favorite ATM. Since 2021, more than $5 billion has landed at that airport. Rep. Tim Burchett's summary is hard to beat: "The terrorists can hate us for free." Instead, we invoice ourselves.
Do the math the bill's backers do: $40 million a week is $2.08 billion a year -- the Taliban's annual allowance from Uncle Sam, flowing to the crowd that killed 2,000 Americans and wounded 20,000 more, and now taxes every pallet we airlift. It's a subscription. Nobody in Washington has canceled.
Congress noticed. In January 2025, Burchett introduced the No Tax Dollars for Terrorists Act, which orders the State Department to do what you'd have assumed was already in the job description: build and run a strategy to deter foreign governments and NGOs from bankrolling the Taliban. On June 23, 2025 -- fifteen months ago -- the House passed it. Then the bill flew to the Senate, where, unlike the cash, it has not been permitted to land.
It sat in the Foreign Relations Committee for seven months before Senator Risch reported it out on January 29, 2026 -- "one of the most common sense bills we've considered in years," he said, high praise given the competition. It emerged wearing an amendment, because after fifteen months the Senate apparently needed to attach homework. On February 10, 2026, it was placed on the Senate Legislative Calendar. Calendar No. 330.
February 10 was 230 days ago. In those 230 days -- thirty-three weeks -- another $1.3 billion has landed in Kabul. Calendar No. 330 is the Senate's Hotel California: bills check in, and they check out only when the Majority Leader calls their name. Who calls names? One man: John Thune. You don't need sixty votes to schedule a vote. You need one phone call from one man in South Dakota.
Instead of making that call, the Senate took a reported thirty-seven-day summer vacation, gaveling in for a few pro-forma seconds every few days so the chamber would never officially be in recess -- and President Trump could never make recess appointments. The Senate did not want to work, and it made sure the President could not work either. It is the only coalition Washington assembled all year: Thune and his calendar, shoulder to shoulder against a voter mandate.
Thune's defense is that he is the guardian of a "deliberative body." Pressed on why the President's priorities -- including the House-passed $95 billion reconciliation package with the SAVE Act's election-integrity funding -- weren't first on the floor, Thune told TIME, "Show me how this ends." At a press conference he joked that if Trump "could find somebody else to do this job, it might be a big relief." Sir, no one is asking you to do the whole job. We're asking for one vote. You're holding a fire hose and calling it decor.
Nero at least fiddled over a fire he had started. Thune fiddles over a fire he could extinguish by lifting one finger -- and the fuel is our money.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/38477bc3-e2e6-4da2-8ae4-d5387c6fc27c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Exhibit B is SNAP, and this one Congress actually did pass. The One Big Beautiful Bill, signed July 4, 2025, tightened eligibility so food stamps go to citizens and lawfully present residents rather than to whoever arrives with the best paperwork. Then 21 Democratic state attorneys general sued, winning a "hold-harmless" that stretched enforcement to April 9, 2026, while states with high error rates won delays running to 2029 and 2030. Pass a law. Get sued. Extend the deadline. That is not stopping spending -- that is subscribing to it.
Scale, please: SNAP runs about $8 billion a month -- roughly $96 billion a year, the equivalent of forty-six years of Taliban cash deliveries. And the machine does respond to a firm hand: between July 2025 and February 2026, about 3.5 million people came off the rolls. Enforcement works. What it does not work with is a calendar curated like a rare-book room. October 1 -- the day states start picking up 75 percent of SNAP's administrative costs -- and Congress is already drafting its favorite verb: delay.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/be248660-12e5-4264-a008-24517404c6a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Exhibit C is the slow one, and the biggest. On June 30, 2025, Senator Bill Hagerty and eighteen colleagues introduced the Equal Representation Act: one citizenship question on the 2030 census, House seats and electoral votes for citizens only. That is not a survey tweak. It is the deed to the decade. The 2030 count locks in every district and every electoral vote through 2042, and it decides whether sanctuary states keep seats padded with people who cannot vote. Projections already hand Texas four seats and take four from California; counting illegal aliens claws part of that back for Democrats. Count citizens, and the map snaps back to the people who actually vote, for ten years. Hagerty's bill has now sat in the Homeland Security Committee for fifteen months -- not reported, not scheduled. On September 10 the Senate convened at 3:01 p.m. -- precise to the second, unable to count to citizen. The law gives the Census Bureau its subject list three years before Census Day -- 2027\. Miss that, and the maps are rigged by arithmetic until 2042.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7678fcf4-747b-4d9e-931b-b6e6e4884a3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
To be fair to the Taliban bill: it does not switch off the airlift itself -- UN cash pays vendors and salaries, and the Taliban's cut is skim and tax. But it is the vehicle Congress chose, and it has sat on a calendar for 230 days. There is no heavier lift in Washington than lifting a finger.
The 2024 voters did not elect a museum curator; they elected a wrecking crew and got a docent. America-last spending does not die in conference committee; it dies of natural causes on a calendar -- $40 million a week, $8 billion a month, and a census form that expires once every ten years. One phone call. Calendar No. 330. The terrorists can hate us for free -- the Senate bills us by the hour. Fiddle. Fiddle. Fiddle.

Recess and pro-forma sessions per TIME, Politico, The Economist (June-July 2026). #

Peter –

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140174125/649758801/599209101?refcode=260928-email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MmI3NjkzMC05M2JiLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UIEzs74H9G3_p4hrP1mTAgTAT9oxhVA22Se50h637pE=)
---
Friend, Working people built Tennessee. _**They deserve an economy that pays them back.**_ Our neighbors deserve more than Republican extremist Chuck Fleischmann, who is more than happy to show up for corporate PACs and the billionaire class but disappears when working families are struggling to survive. That is why he hasn’t held a town hall in 15 years. And why he proudly says he will never have another one. Now, there’s a real choice on the ballot. We’re proud that **Anna Golladay** is our Democratic nominee for U.S. Congress in District 3. She’ll be a champion for working families in Washington. **Anna is a progressive faith leader, small business owner, and dedicated community leader from Chattanooga.** For years, she’s watched Washington reward the rich and powerful while forgetting the working families in her district. District 3 deserves a representative who answers to the people, not to corporate pocketbooks. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140174126/649758802/1583080928?refcode=260928-email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MmI3NjkzMC05M2JiLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UIEzs74H9G3_p4hrP1mTAgTAT9oxhVA22Se50h637pE=) That’s why she refused to sit on the sidelines any longer and watch it keep happening to her and her neighbors. **Now, Victoria Broderick is our Democratic nominee for U.S. Congress in District 4. ** | [SPLIT A DONATION BETWEEN THE TNDP & ANNA GOLLADAY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140174127/649758803/599209101?refcode=260928-email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MmI3NjkzMC05M2JiLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UIEzs74H9G3_p4hrP1mTAgTAT9oxhVA22Se50h637pE=)

clean_body: Don’t listen to them! | | | | Everyone doubted us. They didn’t believe that we could win in 2018, but we made history. Right here in Wisconsin, we pulled off a major victory when Democrats, Independents, and even some Republicans came together to help me defeat Scott Walker in 2018. It was the first time in over a decade that a Democrat sat in the Governor’s office, and when we won, we made historic investments in our infrastructure, schools, and economy. But, Derek, believe me when I tell you Tom Tiffany is worse than Scott Walker. If he has his way, all of our progress could be destroyed. Democrats want to invest in Wisconsin; MAGA wants to invest in themselves. That is why I am dedicated to electing David Crowley in November. David is ready to take on Trump and deliver for working families. Texans have lost trust in our government, and for good reason -- Greg Abbott has hoarded our money and prioritized cashing checks from donors while we struggle with the costs of healthcare, electricity, groceries, gas, and housing.
**As governor, I will put money in your pocket. I will sign a proclamation declaring the high cost crisis an emergency in the state of Texas, freeze electricity rates and call on the legislature to issue $1,500 to every Texas household.**
Abbott has sat in the Governor's mansion for over a decade and in that time he's allowed property taxes to increase 85%. And he will continue to raise your taxes. He took over Houston ISD and then increased their property taxes. Now he's taken over Fort Worth ISD, Beaumont ISD, and he's threatening Austin. He takes over the school districts to send vendor contracts to his donors. That is the Greg Abbott Corruption Tax.
Not only has he taken money out of our pockets by not reigning in high property taxes, he's starved our neighborhood schools for his $1 billion voucher scam and allowed electricity costs to skyrocket after he handed over our grid to massive data centers.
Greg Abbott has sold Texas out to billionaires and big corporations but left us to foot the bill. Every single day, people in this state work harder and get less. Meanwhile, about 15 billionaires at the top are running the show and driving costs up for everything.
Texas is a world economic powerhouse because of the grit of hardworking Texans. But Greg Abbott and establishment politicians have prioritized putting taxpayer money in the pockets of global corporations at the expense of investment in Texans. Whether it's skyrocketing property taxes, electricity bills, healthcare costs, or the data centers that he's welcomed into our state, we pay more and get less under Abbott.
I'm running against Abbott to change that. As Governor, my top priority will be securing the American Dream for working Texans. That's why I'm committed to a $1,500 corruption tax refund, freezing electricity rates, lowering costs, making homeownership accessible again, and cutting property taxes.
You can read more about my "**Money in Your Pocket** " Plan on my campaign **[website](https://substack.com/redirect/003dfd65-dbc9-423f-9d90-3875286f0bf9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
**Abbott can spread all the lies he wants about me and my record, but we know the truth: For 30 years, Greg Abbott has been doing the bidding of his billionaire donors. There is no town he won 't sell out, no business he won't close, and no person he won't leave behind.**
Let's get him out of the Governor's mansion once and for all -- because after years of Texans paying the price for his corruption, it's time we had a Governor who pays us back.
Thanks for being in this fight with me,
Gina

I've served this country in Congress for nearly a decade. I AM home. So are the millions of Indian Americans, immigrants, and children of immigrants he's telling to get out.
This isn't a one-off. His own city council already censured him after he demanded every Indian be deported. He didn't stop. He didn't apologize. He doubled down, because in today's GOP, racism isn't a scandal that costs you anything. It's a strategy that gets you attention, and sometimes, it gets you reelected.
I'm done just calling it out. Equal Opportunity Now exists to defeat people like him and elect leaders who believe this country belongs to all of us, no matter what our names sound like.

Susan Collins has billionaire lobbyists in her corner. Troy Jackson has loggers, union members, and working families. I know which side I’m on. And right now, you can show Troy exactly how many people are ready to stand with him in this fight to unseat Susan Collins and take back our Senate majority. His end-of-quarter deadline is September 30.
